title: reflection-heal: model-shared living-reflection maintenance (merit-rank, recency-grace, pin-ladder, ROOT grades)
desc: The MODEL-AGNOSTIC maintenance method for EVERY model reflection (haiku/sonnet/opus/gpt/gemini). Keeps a reflection a lean, high-signal, self-organizing LIVING record instead of an ever-fattening dump: failures add reflexes, successes promote proven ones, time+merit sort, ROOT grades systematically. Merit-ranked 3-tier + recency-grace + pin ladder. Required by jisikhwa + agent-failure-reflection-gate.
steps: PURPOSE + SCOPE -- MODEL-AGNOSTIC. This one method maintains EVERY model reflection identically: haiku-reflection, sonnet-reflection, opus-self-reflection, gpt-mini-reflection, gemini-flash-reflection, and any future model -- Haiku gets graded exactly like Sonnet and Opus, no model is exempt. A reflection is a LIVING record that MUST keep accumulating lived lessons; you NEVER prune knowledge, you REDISTRIBUTE it by proven merit so the reflection stays lean + high-signal instead of a dump whose own tier-score then penalizes it.

MERIT-RANKED 3-TIER DISTRIBUTION. Rank every reflex by proven effectiveness, then place by rank: T1 core = the top proven-effective reflex RULES (terse, high-score); T2 howto = below-median but still-actionable patterns; T3 ref = dated incident narratives + evidence (no score pressure). A NEW lesson defaults to T3-ref (raw incident) and GRADUATES to T1 only when it proves effective. CLASS-DEDUP: same-class reflexes collapse to ONE T1 rule with an instance-list in ref (FORCE=1 / env-var override / marker-delete / warn-not-block = one gate-bypass-backdoor rule), never N separate steps.

RECENCY GRACE (under 7 days = protected). A reflex added within the last 7 days is EXCLUDED from demotion even if unproven -- it has not had TIME to fire, and demoting a day-old reflex kills it before it can prove itself. Only steps 7+ days old are demotion candidates. Mirrors the md-diet archive-only-over-1-week rule; objective + timestamp-based = easy to automate and audit.

SYMMETRIC TRIGGERS -- failures GROW, successes CURATE. FAILURE side: a delegation/mission FAILURE forces ROOT to RECORD a new reflex (agent-failure-reflection-gate), entering at the BOTTOM, grace-protected. SUCCESS side (the mirror, easy to forget): when a mission SUCCEEDS and a reflex demonstrably contributed (its skill was read + applied and the guarded mistake did NOT recur), that reflex earns an ORDER-UP PROMOTION. Do NOT blind-promote on every success -- gate on objective effect.

OBJECTIVE EFFECT SIGNAL. Promote/demote on EVIDENCE, not whim. Primary = guard-block-recurrence-failure-score DELTA: dropping = the behavior stopped recurring = the reflex works = PROMOTE; rising = still failing = escalate up the pin-ladder or keep. Secondary = demonstrated cause-of-success or cause-of-failure, and explicit user confirmation.

PIN LADDER -- strength rungs, climbed as a reflex proves more critical. Rung 1 = a skill [PIN] marker on the step -> exempt from demotion, frozen in T1 core regardless of age or merit. Rung 2 = a ROW in the CLAUDE.md Emergency Reflexes table -> session-visible, read at the TOP of every session (the incident-trauma-reflex mechanism). Rung 3 = a HARNESS GUARD -> mechanical enforcement so the model CANNOT violate it (the ultimate pin; only for mechanizable reflexes). The CLAUDE.md Emergency Reflexes table IS the curated pinned-reflex registry -- manage pins there.

GRADING IS ALWAYS ROOT'S SYSTEMATIC DUTY. The merit scoring -- who promotes, who demotes, who pins -- is ALWAYS performed by ROOT, SYSTEMATICALLY, and NEVER delegated to a cheap model. Grading is JUDGMENT that shapes what every lower intelligence stands on (foundation-is-roots-charge); a cheap model self-grading its OWN reflexes games the score or mock-PASSes (confident-wrong). ROOT SCORES + DECIDES promote/demote/pin from the objective signals; the fleet may ONLY EXECUTE the mechanical edits ROOT decided (re-add-at-top + remove-old, move-narrative-to-ref). The fleet never scores itself. BUG RULE (owner 2026-10-03): this skill and every spokesman reflex are for the SPOKESMAN ONLY, so if a haiku or any small model ROOT or SECTOR loads a spokesman reflex (this skill, the spokesman constitution tiers, the SPOKESMAN HANDOFF text of a CLAUDE.md, the spokesman lines of the global CLAUDE.md) THAT IS A BUG. Measured 2026-10-03: a WKAppBot haiku root read the handoff section, acted as the spokesman and relaunched a kih root and a second WKAppBot root, so two roots ran in one repo. DETECT by grepping a small model transcript for those skill reads and for wkroot launch or resume run by a root. FIX THE LOAD PATH, not the model: keep spokesman text out of every file and skill a small model reads, and file a wkappbot suggest for each occurrence.

THE FULL SELF-DRIVING LOOP. FAILURE -> add reflex at bottom (grace-protected). SUCCESS/proven-effect -> promote up. aged 7+ days AND unproven AND not-[PIN] -> demote to howto/ref. [PIN] -> frozen core. ROOT grades every pass from the objective signals. Failures GROW the record, successes CURATE it, time+merit SORT it -- a cybernetic living reflection that self-organizes toward high-signal, per model, forever. Run it per model against that model OWN reflection cluster.

TOOLING + AUTOMATION (build these to make it turnkey). (a) wkappbot skill edit --promote-step N to reorder a step up -- NOT yet implemented (see skill-edit-step-ordering-spec); until then promote = re-add-at-top + remove-old. (b) a periodic reflection-heal pass, sibling of md-heal / skill-heal-nightly, that recomputes rank, applies recency-grace, demotes the sunk bottom, collapses same-class steps -- ROOT-graded. (c) a SUCCESS-side hook, sibling of agent-failure-reflection-gate, surfacing promotion candidates on mission success. SIBLINGS: md-heal, skill-heal-nightly, guard-block-recurrence-failure-score, foundation-is-roots-charge, incident-trauma-reflex, knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa.

MULTI-SOURCE PROMOTION + RESURRECTION (user 2026-07-13) -- a step rises via THREE independent signals, and the third is the TRUEST living reflex: (1) AGENT SELF-PROMOTION: a delegated model, after finishing its task, nominates the step(s) IT found decisive from lived experience (self-scored, not ROOT's guess). (2) ROOT PROMOTION: ROOT grades systematically and lifts exactly ONE step per pass (the pin-ladder single-step promote already specified). (3) RESURRECTION / RE-SUMMON (the key insight): a step that was NOT selected and got demoted to T3/ref is NOT dead -- attach a RECALL COUNTER to every demoted step; when that ref-tier step gets RE-referenced/re-invoked because it became relevant again, promote it back UP. Weight this signal HIGHEST -- above a fresh nomination -- because survival-through-demotion-THEN-recall is the strongest possible evidence of a genuine reflex (vs a one-off that merely looked good once). CONSEQUENCE: the ref tier is NOT a graveyard, it is a DORMANT POOL with recall tracking; steps flow DOWN when quiet and flow BACK UP when re-triggered, exactly like a real neural pathway that re-strengthens on re-use. That two-way flow (down on silence, up on resurrection) is what makes the reflex tree actually ALIVE rather than a static ranked list. IMPL NOTE: the success-promotion proto (wkharness-agent-success-promotion-proto.ps1) should record a recall count per demoted step and surface a resurrection candidate the moment a ref-tier step is cited again.

HUMAN VOTE = the 4th and HIGHEST-AUTHORITY signal (user 2026-07-13, half-joke-but-real 'a like button on each step, and a dislike too?'). On top of the 3 automatic promotion signals (agent self-promote / ROOT promote / resurrection), add a per-step human up/down vote: THUMBS-UP = promote one rung now (the user directly certified this reflex earned it -- outranks every automatic signal because it is ground-truth human judgment); THUMBS-DOWN = demote one rung toward T3/ref, and a step that keeps collecting down-votes is PRUNED (dead reflex, stop paying its token rent every session). Pairs with RESURRECTION: a down-voted step lands in the dormant ref pool, NOT the trash -- if it is recalled/re-cited later it still earns another shot (a human 'no' is 'not now', not 'never'; only repeated down-votes with no recall = prune). This makes the merit rank a blend of lived-experience (agent), systematic grading (ROOT), proven-under-fire (resurrection), and direct human will (vote) -- vote wins ties. IMPL: a lightweight 'wkappbot skill vote <id> <step#> up|down' command that nudges the step's rank + logs the voter; cheap to add, and it turns ROOT's abstract 'grade systematically' into a concrete one-tap action the user can also drive.

HIPPO-INDEXED VOTE ANALYTICS (user 2026-07-13) -- the observability pillar. Log every --like/--dislike/promote/demote as a vote EVENT (skill-id, step#, actor, direction, timestamp, one-line reason) and let wkhippo index those events across ALL sessions and ALL models. That converts the reflex tree from a local rank tweak into a MEASURABLE cross-session leaderboard, queryable: (a) MOST-LIKED steps = globally proven reflexes; (b) MOST-RESURRECTED steps = survived demotion THEN recall = strongest evidence of a real reflex; (c) TRENDING-UP vs DECAYING-DOWN steps over time; (d) PER-MODEL taste = which reflexes a given model up-votes (Haiku vs Sonnet vs Opus may value different steps). The votes become DATA, so ROOT's periodic grade pass LEADS with the hippo leaderboard instead of guessing, and the fleet can see which knowledge actually earns its token rent. This is what makes 'living reflex' AUDITABLE rather than merely asserted -- the two-way flow (down on silence, up on resurrection) plus a hippo-indexed vote ledger = a self-measuring knowledge tree. Cross: wkhippo (the cross-AI index that aggregates the vote events).

THREE-TIER IDENTITY BY KIND (user 2026-07-13, 'what is howto's identity?') -- each tier of the living tree has a distinct KIND and a distinct evolution mechanism, and this UNIFIES the skill-kind vote-guard with the tier structure: T1 CORE = the reflex layer, 'what + why', MERIT-kind -> reorders by the like/dislike VOTE (rank = importance). T2 HOWTO = the PROCEDURE layer, 'how to execute', SEQUENCE-kind -> order = dependency/time, so votes are REFUSED (this IS the sequential skill the skill-kind guard protects); howto's aliveness is NOT rank competition but PROCEDURAL CORRECTION -- steps get inserted / edited / deleted as the recipe gets more accurate. T3 REF = the archive/dormant pool, incidents + impl history, ARCHIVE-kind -> driven by RECALL/RESURRECTION. TIER FLOW (the living part): a T3 ref pattern that RECURS enough promotes UP to a T2 howto (a one-off becomes a repeatable procedure); a T2 howto insight that hardens into an always-true principle DISTILLS UP to a T1 core reflex; a T2/T1 step that goes stale DEMOTES DOWN to T3 ref (dormant, not deleted -- resurrection still possible). So the vote/like system is a T1(merit) mechanism ONLY; T2 evolves by correction; T3 by recall. howto's identity = the order-locked procedural bridge between principle (T1) and archive (T3).

requirements.expect: model-shared merit-rank + recency-grace + pin-ladder maintenance method
the objective effect signal ROOT grades from
grading is ROOT judgment, never delegated to a cheap model
